title: The Components guides teach Edit Original instead of clicking the original on the page
goal: Three of the Components tutorials (Use it again and again, Override one copy, A button in all its states) tell you to click the original on the page. Since a component's original now lives in the Library and opens with Edit Original, those guides stop at their first or second card. Rewrite them so they walk a person through Edit Original and Done, and they work end to end again.
notes: Fallout of dropping-a-component-puts-down-one-instance-and (2026-10-04): originals moved off the canvas into PhotonzDocument.componentOriginals; Edit Original opens EditorState+OriginalSpace (a space document, Done in the title bar, Esc with nothing picked, Layer > Done Editing Original). Make a component was already updated in that task (its name-it step points at panelSection("libraryItem")). Failing today: tutorial-component-versions-walk step 15 waits for name-it (the guide says Click the original, which is a copy now); tutorial-override-one-copy-walk step 15 Add menu has no Label Wording (the copy is picked, not the original); tutorial-use-it-again-and-again-walk step 37 press @fill (pick-the-original card). Likely needs a new TutorialTrigger (originalOpened, raised in editOriginal) and one for Done, since layerSelected fires on the right-click before the space opens. Harness actions editPickedComponentOriginal / doneEditingOriginal exist. In a space a made component opens where the group stood; a starter opens centred on a page the document's size (ComponentLibrary.editingSpace).
acceptance: Each of the three guides runs from first card to last at Next defaults, with every card pointing at something on screen

Wherever a guide used to say click the original (the drawing wearing four diamonds), it says to right-click a copy and choose Edit Original, or to use the Library tile, and a later card says to press Done
The guide walks tutorial-use-it-again-and-again-walk, tutorial-override-one-copy-walk and tutorial-component-versions-walk pass
No guide grows past the step budget its track tests allow

log.note: Reproduced on HEAD da42b583 (probe built 17:42, after the commit): Scripts/playtest-all.sh --no-build tutorial-use-it-again / tutorial-override-one-copy tutorial-component-versions -> use-it-again FAILED step 37 (press @fill: no row, the copy is picked, not the original); component-versions FAILED step 15 (name-it never came: Add on a copy has no A second Variant); override FAILED step 15 (Add menu rows: Shadow, Glow, Border, Blur, no Label Wording). Adversarial pass 1: a first-time user now has nothing on the page to click that is the original (every button on the page is a copy, the sample's original is parked into the Library at load), so every 'click the original' card is a dead end. A Figma user expects right-click > Edit main component, so the cards say right-click a button and choose Edit Original; the original opens picked, so the panel steps that follow (Color, Properties/Add) point at the right section. Done is a new event and a new ring target (the Done button in the title bar), and a new 'original opened' event, because a right-click picks the copy first and would satisfy a layerSelected wait. Budget: states guide is at 8 already, so its canvas payoff 'all four together' becomes the Done card (the four drawings are only together inside the space now) and the last card is the copy picking its state. Others grow to 7.
